params.expression:
CASE
    WHEN students.created_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.created_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.created_at)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.modified_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.modified_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.modified_at)
END

CASE
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(gender)) IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'MALE'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(gender)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'FEMALE'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(gender)) IN ('O', 'OTHER', 'OTHERS') THEN 'OTHERS'
    ELSE NULL
END
(COALESCE(exp_year, 0) * 12) + COALESCE(exp_month, 0)

CASE
    WHEN physically_handicapped IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(physically_handicapped)) = 'YES' THEN TRUE
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(physically_handicapped)) IN ('NO', '0') THEN FALSE
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN marital_status IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(marital_status) = '0' THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(marital_status) = '----' THEN 'OTHER'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(marital_status)) IN ('MARRIED') THEN 'MARRIED'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(marital_status)) IN ('UNMARRIED', 'SINGLE') THEN 'UNMARRIED'
    ELSE 'OTHER'
END

CASE
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(student_enrollment_details.locality)) = 'URBAN' THEN 'URBAN'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(student_enrollment_details.locality)) = 'RURAL' THEN 'RURAL'
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.created_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.created_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.created_at)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.modified_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.modified_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.modified_at)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.batch_id = 154 THEN 152
    WHEN students.batch_id = 176 THEN 174
    ELSE students.batch_id
END

CASE
    WHEN students.campaign_id = 7695 THEN 7574
    WHEN students.campaign_id = 7702 THEN 7568
    WHEN students.campaign_id = 7745 THEN 7579
    WHEN students.campaign_id = 7746 THEN 7580
    WHEN students.campaign_id = 7781 THEN 7577
    ELSE students.campaign_id
END

CASE
    WHEN students.course_id IN (679) THEN 5
    WHEN students.course_id IN (680) THEN 6
    WHEN students.course_id = 681 THEN 8
    WHEN students.course_id = 682 THEN 7
    ELSE students.course_id
END

CASE
    WHEN students.call_status IN (29, 31) THEN 58
    ELSE students.call_status
END

CASE students.call_sub_status
    WHEN 36 THEN 72
    WHEN 37 THEN 73
    WHEN 38 THEN 74
    WHEN 39 THEN 75
    WHEN 41 THEN 76
    WHEN 42 THEN 77
    WHEN 43 THEN 78
    WHEN 52 THEN 79
    WHEN 53 THEN 80
    WHEN 54 THEN 81
    ELSE students.call_sub_status
END

CASE
    WHEN students.enquire_date IS NOT NULL
         AND students.enquire_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.enquire_date)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.reenquire_date IS NOT NULL
         AND students.reenquire_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.reenquire_date)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.ip_generation_date IS NOT NULL
         AND students.ip_generation_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.ip_generation_date)
END

CASE
    WHEN TRIM(students_extra_fields.year_of_graduation) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
    THEN CAST(TRIM(students_extra_fields.year_of_graduation) AS UNSIGNED)
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.expected_date IS NOT NULL
         AND students.expected_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.expected_date)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.currency IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(students.currency) = '0' THEN NULL
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(students.currency)) = 'INR' THEN 'Domestic'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(students.currency)) = 'USD' THEN 'International/NRI'
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.course_id = 625 THEN 2
    WHEN students.course_id = 626 THEN 3
    WHEN students.course_id = 627 THEN 1
    WHEN students.course_id = 628 THEN 5
    WHEN students.course_id = 674 THEN 4
    WHEN students.course_id = 750 THEN NULL
    WHEN students.course_id = 751 THEN 6
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.course_id IN (625, 626, 627) THEN 2
    WHEN students.course_id IN (628, 674) THEN 1
    WHEN students.course_id = 750 THEN 2
    WHEN students.course_id = 751 THEN 2
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.refer_lead_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
         AND CAST(students.refer_lead_id AS UNSIGNED) > 0
    THEN students.refer_lead_id
    ELSE NULL
END

CASE
    WHEN students.created_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.created_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.created_at)
END

CASE
    WHEN students.modified_at IS NOT NULL
         AND students.modified_at <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
    THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(students.modified_at)
END
